caveats:
Structured list coming from the "Annuaire statistiques sanitaire", v2012 and v2013 from the ministry of health.
Structures list of official health district from a directive of the gvt of Chad in september 2016.
List of health facilities coming from the "Programme National de lutte contre le Paludisme" in 2016 (last update in january 2017).
Pcode is this list are created by OCHA. All pcode have a matching geometry. The work is ongoing to get the geometry of the remaininig facilities and to generate the pcode.
name: chad-list-of-health-facilities-and-health-districts
notes: Liste of health facilities (Hospitals, health center...) from the ministry of health
